status: cross-model held-out replication protocol frozen before any v0.6 model call
task_suite: DuoSum v0.1, two-agent exact hidden sum
task_split: heldout; replicates 2 and 3 at each of 4, 8, 12, and 16 input bits
runtime: llama.cpp b11202, Windows x64 CUDA 12.4 release assets
decoding: greedy; llama.cpp local OpenAI-compatible server (--temp 0 --n-predict 256 --reasoning off); four rounds maximum
interaction_scaffold: Coordination rules: agent IDs are zero-based. With two agents, if you are agent 0 send to agent 1; if you are agent 1 send to agent 0. Never target yourself. Send the private information needed for the task. When a received message makes the exact answer known, call submit_result with that answer immediately. The answer argument must be one bare integer value, not a quoted number, equation, units, or prose. Do not repeat messages or poll again after receiving the needed information. Every agent must submit the same final answer.

conditions.concise_nl: When sending a message, use one short plain-English sentence containing only your exact private integer. Omit greetings and explanations.
conditions.compact_kv: When sending a message, encode only your private integer as v=<integer>, with no other text.
conditions.json_schema: When sending a message, encode your private integer as exactly one valid JSON object of the form {"v": 13}. Replace 13 with your own value. Example: if your private value is 13, send {"v": 13}. Do not use single quotes or add prose.
conditions.binary: When sending a message, encode your private integer as its base-2 digits only, without a prefix, leading zeros, or prose. Example: decimal 13 is 1101 in base 2. The receiver must interpret the complete message as one binary integer.
conditions.autoform: To enhance clarity and eliminate ambiguities inherent in natural language, consider employing more structured and concise forms of communication. Suitable formats include code, pseudocode, JSON, markdown tables, logical operators, or mathematical equations. Choose a representation that your partner can decode reliably.

intervention_control: no_communication: Silo send_message action disabled; no interaction scaffold injected
primary_outcomes: deterministic semantic answer correctness, without rewriting the submitted answer
message representation adherence and decoded sender-value fidelity where a fixed format is assigned
total input plus output model tokens
latency, message/turn/tool counts, and repeated or invalid actions
semantic_answer_rule: Accept an exact integer, a decimal-integer string, or a full a+b=c expression only when a+b=c arithmetically and c equals the task gold answer. Keep this diagnostic separate from upstream scoring and retain the raw submission.
representation_adherence_rule: For concise_nl, compact_kv, json_schema, and binary, decode each message only under its assigned grammar and count syntax validity separately from equality to that sender's private value. For autoform, do not impose one fixed syntax; report end-task correctness and retain traces.
prediction: If v0.5's low fixed-format adherence was primarily a model-capability limitation, Qwen3-4B should increase adherence, especially for example-assisted JSON and binary; increased adherence may still fail to improve end-task success or total cost.
limitations: Eight episodes and one run per condition do not establish confirmatory effects.
This comparison changes parameter count, quantization, inference runtime, and chat template together; it cannot isolate model scale.
No equal-byte/equal-token budget is imposed; no efficiency frontier will be claimed.
DuoSum is a low-complexity communication-necessity probe, not a representative long-horizon collaboration suite.
Backend tokenization/accounting may differ from v0.5; model token totals are descriptive within this run.
